items.title: LILLEY: Navdeep Bains arrives at Queen's Park smiling, but baggage won't stay buried
Google says 'lawful access' bill creates 'attractive' opportunities for bad actors
items.summary: A provision in the federal 'lawful access' bill requiring companies to keep months of people’s metadata gives criminals a new avenue of attack, a senior Google official told senators Monday.

items.title: What if Quebec’s premier refuses to swear allegiance to the King?
items.summary: Members of the National Assembly (MNA) unanimously declined to swear allegiance to the King when they were sworn in after this fall’s provincial election.
